newsitem.title: UK: Frontline to issue 10mln shares to buy new tankers.
newsitem.headline: Frontline to issue 10mln shares to buy new tankers.

text.p: Norwegian tanker operator Frontline Ltd said Friday it intends to issue 10 million new shares in order to exercise options to acquire three Suezmax and four VLCC newbuilding contracts.

Frontline said in a statement to the Oslo bourse: "In order to finance the exercise of the options for the three Suezmax tankers the company's board of directors have resolved a private placement of 10 million new shares to four large institutional investors who are new shareholders in the company."
Issue price for the new shares will be $3.84 per share and they have been placed by Carnegie and Fearnley Fonds, Frontline said.
The placement is subject to agreement at a special general meeting of the company which will be called immediately and is expected to take place on July 23.
Hemen Holding BV, which owns approximately 65 percent of the shares in Frontline, has undertaken to vote in favour of the issue, the company said.

The shipbuilding options were included in the Frontline's introduction prospectus to the Oslo Stock Exchange, dated July 4, 1997. Before that date the company was listed in Stockholm. -Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087. Fax 5017.
